data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'Awya' which means 'to advise' or 'to help'. Muayish is a name of wisdom and guidance, evoking images of wise elders and spiritual guides. The name Muayish carries the meaning “Wise adviser” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose Muayish usually hope their child will grow to embody wise adviser and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun attributes the name 'Muayyad' to the Almohad leader Abd al-Mu'min. He ruled from 1130 to 1163 CE during the Almohad Dynasty in North Africa and Spain. The name 'Muayyad' means 'supported' or 'helped' and was given in recognition of Abd al-Mu'min's military successes.
historical_references.context: Almohad Dynasty, North Africa and Spain

historical_references.reference: The name 'Muayyad Ali Shah' was given to the Mughal Emperor in 1695 CE. He ruled from 1694 to 1712 CE during the Mughal Empire in India. The name 'Muayyad Ali Shah' means 'supported by God' and was given after his victory in the Battle of Bijapur against the Adil Shahs.
